title: Corruptedmod
description: A mod that adds structures, mobs, blocks, and ores. By adding corruption to your worlds
body: This is the Corruption mod. The main purpose of this mod is to add more materials like Hopeium and Corruptium, multiple mobs as Flyers Runners and Blockers, towers and corrupted towers as structures and the corruption dimension. Hopium is a strong starter Material and Corruptium is a cool material to be found in the new corruption dimension and it's very very good. Oh, and a little reminder: Some materials are not as harmless as you think. Have fun exploring and fighting with this mod.
